short: Generated pointer index into the design corpus
is: The generated pointer index into the design corpus (ZurNetwork/zurfur-design) — page ids, statuses and titles only, never copied page content.
conventions: This is the index every `refs` entry resolves against, so it is the one place design page ids belong in bulk — but still ids, statuses and titles, never page bodies.

Generated, never hand-edited: `just design-index` rewrites it from the corpus, `just design-index-check` (inside `just gate`) reports drift, and `just nodes-check` resolves every NODE.json ref against it.

fs.name: design-index.md
fs.role: generated pointer index into the design corpus — one line per page (id, status, title), via `just design-index`
